title: 58th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/58/2024).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 51/2024 to 55/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for a seat on the Board of Directors of the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority under Article 4(b)(2) of the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Foreign Currency Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Inguraidhoo MP Ibrahim Falah.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill to amend the Drugs Act (Law No. 17/2011), submitted on behalf of the government by Gan MP Yoosuf Nasheed.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Attorney General's Office Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau.
Judiciary Committee report on its review of the Bill to amend the Penal Code of the Maldives (Law No. 9/2014).
Judiciary Committee report on its joint review of two bills to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016).
Judiciary Committee report on its review of the Bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015).
Foreign Relations Committee report on its review of the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Kingdom of Thailand.
Independent Institutions Committee report on its review of the President's nominee for membership of the National Integrity Commission.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, send a MIRA board nominee to committee, introduce the Foreign Currency Bill, continue the Drugs Act amendment and Attorney General's Office Bill, and take up five committee reports on criminal-law amendments, an ambassador to Thailand and a National Integrity Commission nominee.
